regs_in_letter: FD&C Act misbranding (false or misleading); no CFR section cited in letter text

cases.claim: VO: “The one thing I love about the TOBI Podhaler is when I am running late, I can do it on the way to school in the car.” | VO: “My favorite things about the TOBI Podhaler are how portable it is, how quick it is to use, and how you can use it anywhere.” | VO: “We have used it on vacation, in the car, and while running out of the door on the way to school.”
cases.context: IFU requires hand washing, clean dry surface, adequate lighting to inspect capsules, moisture protection, and 4-capsule repeat steps; some use info in the video does not mitigate.
cases.rationale: Implies administration can be done anywhere without concern, contrary to IFU steps; improper handling may cause suboptimal dosing.
cases.check: Do convenience claims ('anywhere', 'on the go', 'quick') conflict with Instructions for Use requirements for administration, handling, or storage?
